title: Getting to Know Copilot Cowork Webinar
summary: Copilot Cowork brings new AI to Microsoft 365. Join Xerox and Microsoft to explore use cases, credits, and cost planning so you can adopt with confidence.
body_markdown:
## Curious About Copilot Cowork?


Microsoft is introducing new AI-powered experiences through Copilot Cowork, creating new ways to automate work, increase productivity, and get more from Microsoft 365 Copilot.


But what does that mean for your organization, and how do Copilot Credits, usage-based billing, and cost management factor in?


Join[Xerox IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) and Microsoft for a practical discussion on Copilot Cowork, real-world use cases, and what to consider as you plan for adoption.


### What you'll learn:


-


What Copilot Cowork is and where it can add value


-


Real-world use cases for productivity and automation


-


How Copilot Credits work and when they're consumed


-


Considerations for governance, budgeting, and cost management


-


Practical next steps for evaluating Copilot Cowork


Hear from Microsoft Copilot Partner Solutions Architect Ryan Rager and Xerox IT Solutions Microsoft specialists Jeff Snyder and Ryne Rossetti as they break down what Copilot Cowork could mean for your organization and answer your questions live.


Join us to get your questions answered and prepare for what's next with Copilot.


Register now
